messages.subject: Project Larkspur - Kestrel House, Reading - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We'd like to instruct you on the acquisition of Kestrel House, 14 Forbury Road, Reading - a multi-let office investment we've agreed in principle to buy from Brantwood Asset Management at £14.25m. Heads of terms are being finalised this week.

Can you send over an engagement letter and the AML pack? Day-to-day contact our side is me, with Rebecca Stone on the funding.

Isla

Isla Fournier
Head of Acquisitions
Marchwood Property Group Limited

messages.subject: RE: Project Larkspur - Kestrel House, Reading - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Isla,

Delighted to act. Our engagement letter is attached - please countersign and return with the completed AML pack. Elena Marchetti will run the day-to-day; I'll keep partner oversight.

We've cleared conflicts and confirm we don't act for Brantwood. Fee estimate is £48-55k plus VAT and disbursements on the assumptions set out in the letter.

Kind regards
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner - Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
